FIELDS.NAME: Timeless Treasures Jewelry & Watch Boutique
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Timeless Treasures Jewelry & Watch Boutique, we specialize in offering a curated collection of fine jewelry and watches to our discerning clientele. Our operations focus on retail sales, with a strong emphasis on exceptional customer service and product knowledge. We provide minor on-site repairs, such as ring resizing and battery replacements, ensuring our clients receive the highest level of care. To safeguard our high-value inventory, we have implemented a robust security system that includes 24/7 monitored alarms and surveillance. We prioritize ethical sourcing and conduct thorough employee background checks to mitigate risks of internal theft and maintain trust with our customers. Our written inventory management and loss prevention protocols further support our commitment to operational excellence and safety.
